summary: GameKit is the client API for Apple's Game Center service: player identity, leaderboards, achievements, friends, matches and turn-based play. The service is Apple-hosted and BifrOSt has no Game Center or equivalent online game service, so no counterpart is planned. Local game state is covered by the Games app and the seeded-deck test pin, not by GameKit.

features.note: Game Center sign-in. BifrOSt accounts are bifrost-cloud (bifrost.olibuijr.com/api/cloud/), a different service.
Friend graph lives in Apple's service.

features.feature: Game Center dashboard and access point

features.note: Peer networking through Game Center matchmaking. No BifrOSt multiplayer transport exists.
Game Center stores and forwards match data.

gaps: No online game service, so no leaderboards, achievements or friends. This is an Apple-service dependency, not a missing local API.
No multiplayer peer transport in the SDK.
